covers: The four registers of the Intel 8255 by offset

entries.name: port A read
entries.description: Reads port A: the pins, the output latch or the strobed input latch, by mode.
entries.behaviour: Mode 0 returns the output latch when port A is an output, else the live pins. Mode 1 as an output returns the latch; mode 1 as an input and mode 2 (any direction bit) return the byte a PC4 strobe latched. That read then clears the latch, IBF A and INTR A, except for a debugger read.

entries.name: port A write
entries.description: Writes port A: latches the byte and drives the pins when port A is an output.
entries.behaviour: Mode 0 and mode 1 ignore the write when port A is an input. Mode 1 as an output also sets OBF A to 0 (buffer full) and clears INTR A. Mode 2 always latches and drives, and does the same flag change.

entries.name: port B read
entries.description: Reads port B: the pins, the output latch or the strobed input latch, by mode.
entries.behaviour: Group B mode 0 returns the output latch when port B is an output, else the live pins. Mode 1 as an output returns the latch; mode 1 as an input returns the byte a PC2 strobe latched. That read then clears the latch, IBF B and INTR B, except for a debugger read.

entries.name: port B write
entries.description: Writes port B: latches the byte and drives the pins when port B is an output.
entries.behaviour: The write is ignored when port B is an input. Group B mode 1 as an output also sets OBF B to 0 (buffer full) and clears INTR B.

entries.name: port C read
entries.description: Reads port C: pins, output latch or, in a handshake mode, the status flags.
entries.behaviour: Flags (OBF reads 0 while full): group A mode 1 output PC3 INTR, PC6 INTE, PC7 OBF; mode 1 input PC3 INTR, PC4 INTE, PC5 IBF; mode 2 PC3 INTR, PC4 INTE2, PC5 IBF, PC6 INTE1, PC7 OBF; group B mode 1 PC0 INTR, PC1 OBF or IBF, PC2 INTE. Other bits: output latch or pins by direction.

entries.name: port C write
entries.description: Writes the port C output latch and drives the pins.
entries.behaviour: The byte always goes into the output latch. The pins show the latch for output bits, the tri-state level for input halves (default 0xFF), and the flags in place of the signal bits of a handshake mode. A write never changes a flag.

entries.name: control read
entries.behaviour: The byte is the last mode word written with bit 7 set, 0x9B after a reset. A port C bit set/reset does not change it.

entries.name: control write
entries.description: Writes the control word: a mode set or a port C bit set/reset.
entries.behaviour: Bit 7 set is a mode set, clear a bit set/reset (see the commands). A mode set stores the word, clears the three output latches, the input latches, the INTE enables and IBF, sets OBF to 1 and, for an output port A, IBF A to 1, then redrives the pins. INTR flags are not cleared.
